scenes.text: Every home runs on guesswork. Forgotten subscriptions. Energy burned at the wrong hour. Money that quietly leaks away. Hearth is not an agent. It's a small servant for your household — and it never acts without asking.

Just talk to it. Save me eight hundred dollars. Hearth understands the whole home — energy, pantry, comfort, and every subscription that quietly renews. The answer comes back inline, full screen, structured with live data, and voice only. One question. Four ways to see it.

Behind the conversation sits a cockpit for the household. What is happening. What it costs. What Hearth recommends next. Scenarios you can rehearse before your home ever feels them. Your home, rendered as a system, not a list of gadgets.

Here is the line Hearth never crosses. It proposes. It never executes. Every action waits for you: what will happen, what it saves, why it matters. Approve once — and Hearth carries it out. Trust is built in the pauses.
Your Prime box is late. Hearth already knows. Five dollars drafted. One tap claims it. Sealed in the ledger.

Every action leaves a story. The timeline names every actor — acoustic doctor, family mediator, forensic investigator — and exactly what each one did. Every entry carries its reasoning. No black boxes. No silent decisions.

Insights turn a month of noise into a signal. Money recovered. What's actually in your pantry. How sunlight and load shift through the day. Even a digital twin that rehearses tomorrow before your home lives it.

And when Hearth meets a need nobody coded — a new rate plan, a rule that only your household has — it doesn't wait for an update. It writes the tool itself. Watch. Intent understood. Schema compiled. A safety gate. Source verified. Sandboxed. Smoke tested. Then mounted, live — as tool fifty five. Nothing was shipped. Nothing was hand coded. And every step is on the record.

Trust isn't a promise. It's a proof. Reconstruct three A M: every sensor, every decision, replayed and sealed into a hash-chained Merkle record. The intruder hypothesis? Disproven in seconds, with evidence.
Hearth. Three hundred sixty two tests. Fifty five tools — one of them forged, live, on camera. A home that finally understands itself. And never acts without you. Not an agent. A servant.
